message:
Merge main into issue-706 branch

Resolve seed-registry conflicts by unioning both sides' multilingual
response files and unit test modules, then regenerate the self-AST census.
feat(language): make detection registry-driven from seed data

feat(language): honest language gaps and registry-driven JS parity

- add seed::localized_response implementing the ledger's explicit_gap
  policy and route all 43 response_for(..).or_else(en) sites through it
- port Rust detect_with to the JS worker and derive LANGUAGE_RULES and
  isKnownResponseLanguage from seed data
- record Spanish as detection_mode script_and_markers in the ledger
- close total reference closure for the new registry tokens
- regenerate self-AST census and dumped case artifacts

fix(language): keep script evidence above marker votes

A Latin proper name inside Russian or Chinese text ('Расскажи о julián
andrés quiñones') carries Spanish markers, which made the registry-driven
detector answer in English. Marker rules now only vote when no rival
registered script is present; the fallback script every language borrows
identifiers from is exempt so 'vulkan layer что такое' still detects ru.

Mirrors the rule in the JS worker, adds a mixed-script regression test, and
refreshes the pinned self-AST/self-healing artifacts.

refactor(language): move unknown-intent openers into seed data

The opener pools the unknown-intent fallback varies over lived as four
Rust constants, a JavaScript object literal, and a hard-coded sentence
separator list. Issue #706 requires a new language to be addable without
touching code, so the pools now live in data/seed/unknown-openers.lino
and all three surfaces (Rust core, no_std WASM worker, JS worker) parse
that one file. language_aware_unknown_answer looks its seed text up by
slug instead of matching Language variants, so a registered language
either has a localized unknown answer or reports an explicit gap.

refactor(language): drive language names, concept slugs and script checks from the ledger

Issue #706 requires a new language to be a data edit. The thinking-log
label table, the concept-slug -> language map and the per-language
Unicode range table in the lexeme importer were the last three Rust
branch lists that enumerated languages; all three now read
data/seed/languages.lino and data/seed/language-detection.lino through
new helpers in src/language.rs.

feat(learning): record the language-gap frontier and register it in the learn CLI

The issue-#701 learning cycle was already frontier-agnostic, so teaching
the engine a new language's request frames needs no new learning logic -
only a second recorded frontier. src/language_frontier.rs runs the live
engine over the prompt corpus a contributor ships in
data/language-additions/<slug>.lino and records only the prompts that
still fail; a candidate with no corpus is preserved as an explicit
frontier_gap rather than silently skipped, mirroring the language_gap
coverage policy.

'formal-ai learn cycle --frontier language-gap' now replays that record
through the same cycle Google Trends uses; --frontier became an open
registry lookup instead of a closed Rust enum.

feat(learning): adopt the derived Spanish request frames and pin the capability delta

The language-gap cycle validated two frames on held-out prompts; adopting
them is a pure seed edit in data/seed/learned-request-openers.lino. The
new language adoption ledger replays the frozen pre-adoption frontier
through the live engine and pins the before/after delta byte-for-byte in
data/meta/language-adoption-ledger.lino: 7 of 7 prompts leave the unknown
path and recover their term, so a Spanish request now routes exactly like
its English counterpart. Re-recording the frontier from the same corpus
now yields nothing to learn, which closes the loop.

docs(706): document the language auto-learning loop and refresh derived artifacts

Adds R706-7..9, a changelog fragment, the case-study section describing the
recorded frontier -> shared cycle -> adoption -> pinned capability delta
pipeline, and regenerates the issue-#673 self-AST census for the new and
changed modules.
test(842): re-record the Agent CLI self-heal axis after the issue-706 src edits
style: apply rustfmt to the localized_response migration sites
chore: refresh the self-AST census after formatting
test(842): re-record the self-heal agent trace after the census refresh
test(842): repin the self-hosting session ids to the final-source Agent CLI run
Merge origin/main into issue-706-e78ad8e1b4cf
chore: regenerate derived artifacts after merging origin/main
chore: reclose the seed and re-record the self-hosting evidence on the merged source

message: chore(706): resync the hardcoded-language allowlist and drop the worker unknown-opener bootstrap copy

refactor(706): drive the browser worker's language fallbacks from seed data

The no-WASM fallbacks in the JS worker still carried per-language logic in
code: an inline opener table, a hand-rolled script/marker detector spread
across eight helpers, and a hardcoded list of known response languages.
Registering a fifth language therefore meant editing the worker, breaking the
data-only property issue #706 asks for.

Hydrate the unknown-opener pools from `data/seed/unknown-openers.lino` through
the shared `parseLinoTree`, collapse the detector into a single registry-driven
pass over `LANGUAGE_RULES`, and derive `isKnownResponseLanguage` from the same
registry. All three now read whatever the seed declares, so `es` (and any later
slug) works in the browser mirror with no worker edit.

Net effect on the mirror is +41 lines, so re-baseline the worker line ratchet
from 26_911 to 26_952 with the reason recorded alongside the #699/#701
precedents.

`experiments/issue_706_worker_language_fallback.mjs` loads the worker's
fallback functions against the real seed files and asserts detection for
en/ru/hi/zh/es plus the pool lookup and its fallback-to-en path.

revert(706): restore the explicit seed role re-export list

The glob re-export was a cosmetic refactor unrelated to the any-language
protocol — registering a language adds no Rust symbol, so the explicit list
never blocked a data-only addition — and it drifted the committed self-AST
census in data/meta/self-ast/src/seed.lino. Keep the upstream list.

Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue-706-e78ad8e1b4cf

refactor(706): glob-re-export seed roles to stay under the file-size limit

Merging main pushed src/seed.rs to 1006 lines, past the 1000-line cap that
scripts/check-file-size.rs enforces. `roles` already re-exports its own
submodules with globs, so restating every ROLE_* constant here is redundant;
the glob drops 97 lines and leaves headroom for new roles. Census regenerated.
